name: io.github.omari91/rt-grid-screening-agent
title: Grid Connection Screening Agent
description: Physics-grounded LV/MV/HV grid connection screening: OpenDSS AC, N-1 SCR, SHA-256 audit receipts.

environmentVariables.name: GRID_AGENT_MCP_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Tool scope: 'full' (default), 'tier1_only' (no OpenDSS child processes), or 'readonly'.

environmentVariables.name: GRID_AGENT_AIRGAPPED
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to block all outbound LLM calls (deterministic-only mode).

environmentVariables.name: GRID_AGENT_MAX_DSS_WORKERS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum concurrent isolated OpenDSS worker processes.
